authoritative_2d_raster_rationale: Authoritative independent 10-meter digital flood extent rasters (Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping / NRSC Disaster Watch) remain unreleased in open GIS raster format for this scene. statistical_sanity_audit.scientific_verdict: QUALIFIED: Observations are spatially clustered along the river corridor. Naive Mann-Whitney p = 0.3708 assumes i.i.d. samples. Because adjacent river points share reach-level hydrometeorological forcing, unqualified 'p < 0.05' claims must be qualified as descriptive rather than independent proof of significance.

point_concordance_evaluation_all_points.p_value_qualification: Descriptive directional separation. Naive p < 0.05 is qualified due to reach-level spatial autocorrelation along the river corridor.
